title: Tensor-route transport for an explicit ordinary monoidal structure
statement: For prime ℓ, normed E over ℚ_ℓ, f:X→Y, an explicit monoidal structure m on ordinary integral pullback, a proof that pullback preserves flat objects, and a homotopy complex P of integral module sheaves on Y, the residue exchange tensor comparison equation holds with the derived monoidal structure induced by m and flatness.

proof.text: Prove the route identity on representatives whose ordinary pullback is K-flat, using the derived tensor comparison, the counit normalization of the fixed tensor presentation, and the symmetry move.
Descend the equality from those resolving representatives to every homotopy complex by naturality and cancellation along an isomorphism in the derived category.

proof_origin.note: STATEMENT-DISPUTED: arbitrary m changes the derived tensorator, while the displayed model map fixes the canonical m. Negating a strong monoidal structure gives an odd-residue-characteristic counterexample. Lean attachment withdrawn; canonical parent is proved directly without this node.
